source_row.stem: During an outbreak of a specific infectious organism, a facility may group affected clients together in a designated unit. This practice is known as:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Isolation precautions alone, rather than the specific practice of physically grouping affected clients together","B":"Cohorting, which can help manage limited isolation resources during an outbreak","C":"Standard precautions alone, without any additional grouping or resource-management strategy involved","D":"A practice generally considered to have no established infection control rationale behind its use"}}
source_row.rationale: Cohorting involves grouping clients with the same confirmed infection together, which can help manage limited isolation room resources during an outbreak while still maintaining appropriate precautions.
